dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Can a 67-year-old retired applicant qualify for the Standard plan?

dialogue.speaker: Agent (Sarah)
dialogue.text:
Hello! Thank you for contacting ApexCare Health. My name is Sarah. 

Under our official underwriting guidelines, primary applicants must be between 18 and 65 years of age to qualify for our standard Bronze, Silver, or Gold plans, so a 67-year-old retired applicant cannot qualify for these standard products. I completely understand, however, and let me transfer you directly to our Senior Underwriting Specialist right away to review our specialized Apex Senior Care options for you.
